changes.desc: Added canonical 50-domain technology registry, governance rules, prerequisites, and seeded baseline tiers for 500‑person Nova Roma.
Added domain metadata (category/tags/era), full prerequisite graph, era gating rules, and MSR tech-delta snapshot policy.
Corrected canon starting_population and premise to ~500-person isolated settlement; removed stale 2000-person defaults.
Restored NR_SPEC.json hard-spec and reattached proof-of-load/self-check protocol hooks after v1.1.1 regen dropped the file.

Centralized starting_population in manifest.json. Removed all hardcoded population values from state, template, playability, and documentation files. All systems and users must now reference manifest.json for the authoritative starting population.

Expanded technology_framework domain_codes to include 10+ major domains (Energy, Agriculture, Medicine, Civil Engineering, Infrastructure, Communications, Materials, Transportation, Education, Governance, Sciences, Chemistry, Physics, Biology, Culture) each supporting 100 levels, ensuring comprehensive coverage of civilization's technological spectrum.
